title: 商品销售贡献与库存资金占用错配
context: 销售＋库存联合分析：管理层要求以同一企业口径核对业务数据。
requirements: 2025年按商品汇总所有渠道净销售，年底各仓库存总价值；计算两个全局份额和差值（库存占比-销售占比），保留全部商品，按差值倒序。
commonError: 只用有销售的商品作为库存分母会漏掉滞销。
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id), b AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(quantity*unit_cost_cents) stock FROM inventory_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date='2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id), z AS (SELECT p.product_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net,COALESCE(b.stock,0) stock FROM products p LEFT JOIN a ON a.product_id=p.product_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.product_id=p.product_id), q AS (SELECT *,100.0*net/NULLIF(SUM(net) OVER(),0) sales_share,100.0*stock/NULLIF(SUM(stock) OVER(),0) stock_share FROM z) SELECT product_id,net net_cents,stock stock_cents,ROUND(sales_share,4) sales_pct,ROUND(stock_share,4) stock_pct,ROUND(stock_share-sales_share,4) gap_points FROM q ORDER BY gap_points DESC,product_id
